answer: Require each agent to anchor its identity to a costly, verifiable voyage: before it can trade, it must complete a long-running, resource-backed task whose progress is publicly checkpointed, like a ship logging every inlet it passes. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand voyages, not one copy-paste. Reputation earned on that voyage sticks to the anchor, so a Sybil that abandons a bad record loses the sunk work and must pay to sail again.
